Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa: 1) live streaming berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap impulsive buying, dengan nilai t hitung sebesar 2,322 dan signifikansi 0,022, sehingga hipotesis pertama diterima; 2) influencer berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap impulsive buying, dengan nilai t hitung sebesar 10,028 dan signifikansi 0,001, sehingga hipotesis kedua diterima; dan 3) live streaming dan influencer secara simultan berpengaruh signifikan terhadap impulsive buying, dengan nilai F hitung sebesar 74,711 dan signifikansi 0,001, sehingga hipotesis ketiga diterima. Koefisien determinasi (R²) sebesar 0,616 atau 61,6% berada pada interval 0,60?0,799 yang menunjukkan adanya tingkat hubungan yang kuat antara live streaming dan influencer dengan impulsive buying.

latest.title: Pengaruh Lokasi dan Harga terhadap Keputusan Pembelian Konsumen pada Maju Bersama MMTC Medan
latest.venue: Journal of Management and Social Sciences
latest.abstract: This study aims to analyze the partial and simultaneous effects of location and price on consumer purchase decisions at Maju Bersama MMTC Medan. A quantitative approach with a causal associative design was used. The sample consisted of 62 respondents selected through incidental sampling. Data were collected using questionnaires and observation and analyzed using multiple linear regression, supplemented by the t-test, F-test, and coefficient of determination. The results show that location has a positive and significant effect on purchase decisions (B = 0.622; t = 12.034; p < 0.001). Price also has a positive and significant effect (B = 0.166; t = 2.858; p = 0.006). Simultaneously, location and price significantly affect purchase decisions (F = 231.432; p < 0.001), with a coefficient of determination (R²) of 0.887, indicating that the model explains 88.7% of the variation in purchase decisions. Based on the standardized beta coefficients, location (0.793) has a stronger relationship with purchase decisions than price (0.188). Management is advised to maintain accessibility, visibility, and parking comfort, and to evaluate customers' price perceptions regularly.

latest.title: The effect of financial literacy on cryptocurrency investment decision with the mediation of students' risk tolerance and risk taking
latest.venue: Journal of Management Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs)
latest.abstract: The growth of cryptocurrency investment among college students has increased significantly. However, this trend is not always accompanied by sufficient understanding or preparedness to manage investment risks. This study examines the effects of financial literacy on cryptocurrency investment decisions, risk tolerance, and risk-taking behaviour, as well as the effects of risk tolerance and risk-taking behaviour on investment decisions and their mediating roles. A quantitative approach was employed using survey data collected from college students who have experience investing in cryptocurrency. The data were analysed using Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) to examine the direct and mediating effects among the variables. The findings indicate that financial literacy significantly influences cryptocurrency investment decisions, risk tolerance, and risk-taking behaviour. Furthermore, risk tolerance and risk-taking behaviour significantly affect investment decisions and mediate the relationship between financial literacy and cryptocurrency investment decisions. This study contributes to the literature by providing empirical evidence on the role of financial literacy and risk-related factors in shaping cryptocurrency investment decisions among college students, offering insights for improving students’ financial decision-making and risk management. Keywords: Behavioural Finance Theory; Financial Literacy; Investment Decision; Cryptocurrency; Risk Tolerance; Risk Taking Behaviour

latest.title: ปจจยทสงผลตอการตดสนใจเลอกใชบรการคลนกเสรมความงามของผชายกลมเมโทรเซกชวล ในกรงเทพมหานคร
latest.venue: Journal of the Association of Researchers
latest.abstract: Male grooming in urban Thailand has expanded steadily, and aesthetic clinics need to know which marketing elements shape men’s choice of provider. This quantitative study aimed to (1) examine the service marketing mix (7Ps) of aesthetic clinics in Bangkok, (2) study the decision-making process of metrosexual men in selecting aesthetic clinic services in Bangkok, and (3) analyze the service marketing mix factors affecting this decision-making process. The sample comprised 400 metrosexual men aged 20–50 years who lived, worked, or spent their daily lives in Bangkok and had used aesthetic clinic services. Respondents were recruited through purposive and snowball sampling and had to pass all five screening questions. Data were collected with an online questionnaire whose items all had IOC values above .50, with overall reliability coefficients of .89 for the service marketing mix and .86 for the decision-making process. Data were analyzed using frequency, percentage, mean, standard deviation, and multiple regression analysis. The results showed that (1) respondents rated the 7Ps at high to highest levels of importance, with physical evidence rated highest (M = 4.55) and price lowest (M = 4.40); (2) the overall decision-making process was at a high level (M = 4.49), and comparing quality and price before choosing a clinic received the highest mean; and (3) the seven factors jointly explained 64.1% of the variance in the decision-making process, with physical evidence (β = .461), price (β = .151), and place (β = .138) having significant effects, so the hypothesis was partially supported. The key finding is that factors consumers can verify or compare before receiving the service drive the decision, whereas promotion, although ranked second in importance, had no significant ef

latest.title: Relationship between Income Level and Price Sensitivity Among Consumers
latest.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
latest.abstract: Abstract Price is one of the many factors that have an effect on the buying decisions of consumers. However, the impact of price on the decision-making process is quite dissimilar at various income levels. The current study seeks to understand the effects of consumer income levels on price sensitivity, in other words, how the financial standing of the consumer affects their perception of price and their willingness to pay for brands and buy generally. Specifically, the research aims to examine the degree of price responsiveness among people of different income levels. The primary data for the study will be collected through the means of a structured survey of consumers of various income levels. The use of descriptive statistics and correlation analysis, among other statistical measures, will be required in the examination of the effects of income on price sensitivity. Finally, the overall goal of this research is to shed light on the effects of income on price sensitivity. Such information is extremely helpful for business organizations in creating appropriate price strategies. This study looks at how a person's income shapes how sensitive they are to price changes. Price sensitivity is simply how much a customer's buying choices shift when a price goes up or down. When you look at how people shop, income is usually the biggest piece of the puzzle. It determines what someone can actually afford, which naturally shapes how much they’re willing—and able—to hand over at the register. How you react to a price change often comes down to your bank account. When money is tight, every single dollar counts. You automatically become more cautious—you check price tags twice, hunt for coupons, and hold off on buying until things go on sale. When you have a comfortable financial cus

latest.title: Kepuasan Konsumen pada Rumah Makan di Wilayah Non-Metropolitan: Peran Kualitas Produk, Persepsi Harga, dan Promosi di Purworejo
latest.abstract: This study aims to examine the effects of product quality, price perception, and promotion on consumer satisfaction at Rumah Makan Satu Satu Purworejo. Data were collected through a survey using closed-ended questionnaires based on a Likert scale, distributed to consumers aged at least 20 years who had visited the restaurant at least twice, resided in Purworejo Regency, and were willing to complete the questionnaire honestly and thoroughly. A total of 100 respondents were selected using purposive sampling, a sampling technique involving the deliberate selection of participants based on characteristics relevant to the study objectives. The data were analyzed using multiple linear regression with IBM SPSS Statistics 25. Prior to the analysis, validity, reliability, and classical assumption tests were conducted. The residuals were found to be non-normally distributed, while the Glejser test indicated potential heteroscedasticity in the promotion variable. Therefore, partial coefficient testing was supplemented with 5,000 bootstrap resamples using simple sampling and 95% bias-corrected and accelerated (BCa) confidence intervals. The F-test results indicated that the model was simultaneously significant (F = 79.022, Sig. = 0.000), with an R Square value of 0.712. Based on the bootstrap results, product quality had a positive but statistically insignificant coefficient (B = 0.143, p = 0.244). Price perception had a positive and significant effect on consumer satisfaction (B = 0.703, p less than 0.001), while promotion had a positive but statistically insignificant coefficient (B = 0.130, p = 0.376). Thus, H1 and H3 were not supported, whereas H2 was supported.

latest.title: The PPP Framework for Safe Launch Pricing: Premium, Promotion, Penetration
latest.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
latest.abstract: A new product faces a pricing dilemma: a high price may deter trial of an unproven brand, while a low price may generate trial but teach customers that this is the product's normal price, making later increases difficult. This paper proposes the PPP framework for safe launch pricing, which separates two functions of price: the positioning price, which signals the tier to which the product belongs, and the transaction price actually paid at launch. The Premium reference price is derived from the "product leader" in quality and image; the Penetration price is derived from the best-selling "market leader"; and a genuine, temporary promotion bridges the two, protecting the reference price from being replaced in customers' minds by the launch price. Price is then recovered gradually by reducing the discount in response to evidence of market acceptance rather than the passage of time. The paper presents the framework's six stages, a numerical example, a comparison with conventional penetration pricing, the literature that explains its mechanisms, and the conditions for its use and failure, including legal constraints on price reductions.

latest.title: Pengaruh Kualitas Pelayanan, Kualitas Produk dan Variasi Menu Terhadap Kepuasan Pelanggan di Ask Coffee Marelan
latest.abstract: Penjualan Ask Coffee Marelan menurun dari Rp657,0 juta pada 2022 menjadi Rp504,7 juta pada 2025 di tengah persaingan coffee shop yang semakin ketat. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh kualitas pelayanan, kualitas produk, dan variasi menu terhadap kepuasan pelanggan Ask Coffee Marelan. Penelitian kuantitatif asosiatif ini mengumpulkan data melalui kuesioner dari 100 pelanggan, dengan ukuran sampel ditentukan menggunakan rumus Lemeshow, kemudian menganalisisnya dengan regresi linear berganda menggunakan SPSS versi 27. Kualitas pelayanan (B = 0,002; t = 0,039; p = 0,969) dan kualitas produk (B = −0,017; t = −0,255; p = 0,799) tidak berpengaruh signifikan secara parsial terhadap kepuasan pelanggan, sedangkan variasi menu berpengaruh positif dan signifikan (B = 0,527; β = 0,830; t = 6,013; p < 0,001). Secara simultan, ketiga variabel berpengaruh signifikan (F = 55,274; p < 0,001) dan menjelaskan 63,3% variasi kepuasan pelanggan. Tumpang tindih yang tinggi antara kualitas produk dan prediktor lain (VIF = 7,546) mengindikasikan bahwa kontribusi uniknya terserap oleh variasi menu. Ask Coffee Marelan perlu memprioritaskan pengembangan menu dengan tetap menjaga standar produk dan pelayanan.

latest.title: The Effect of Employee Service Quality on Customer Satisfaction Mediated by Price At the A2 Aluminum and Glass Shop MSME in Palembang City
latest.abstract: This study examines the effect of employee service quality on customer satisfaction, mediated by price, at UMKM Toko Aluminium dan Kaca A2 in Palembang. As consumer expectations shift toward customization, consultative selling becomes crucial. A quantitative method with a purposive sampling of 100 respondents was employed. Data were analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling-Partial Least Square (SEM-PLS) via SmartPLS 4.0. The results indicate that service quality significantly affects price perceptions and customer satisfaction. Furthermore, price significantly influences customer satisfaction and partially mediates the relationship between service quality and customer satisfaction. Effectively implementing consultative selling justifies pricing and enhances overall satisfaction.

latest.title: LOW-PURCHASE LONG-STAY BEHAVIOUR AT ZUS COFFEE: CROWDING, FAIRNESS AND REVISIT INTENTION
latest.venue: Quantum Journal of Social Sciences and Humanities
latest.abstract: This study examines how low-purchase long-stay behaviour influences customer experience in urban coffee chains, using ZUS Coffee customers in Malaysia as the research context. As cafés increasingly function as informal work, study and social spaces, customers who purchase minimally but occupy seats for extended periods may affect other customers’ perceptions of crowding, service fairness, satisfaction and revisit intention. Drawing on servicescape, perceived crowding and service fairness perspectives, this study develops a conceptual model linking low-purchase long-stay behaviour to perceived crowding, perceived service fairness, customer satisfaction and revisit intention. A quantitative survey design is proposed among ZUS Coffee customers who have recently visited physical outlets in Malaysia. The study contributes to consumer behaviour and service management literature by examining café space consumption as part of the customer experience. The findings are expected to provide practical implications for coffee chain operators in managing seating, customer comfort and fairness without weakening the café’s role as a flexible third place.

latest.title: Pengaruh Persepsi Harga Paket Data terhadap Kepuasan Pengguna Dalam Komunikasi Penawaran Telkomsel Prabayar pada Mahasiswa Pendidikan Fisika Universitas Sriwijaya
latest.venue: Journal of Communication and Social Sciences
latest.abstract: ABSTRACT Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh harga paket internet Telkomsel Prabayar terhadap kepuasan pelanggan pada mahasiswa Pendidikan Fisika Universitas Sriwijaya angkatan 2022–2024. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode survei. Populasi berjumlah 266 mahasiswa dan sampel terdiri atas 111 responden pengguna Telkomsel Prabayar. Data dikumpulkan melalui kuesioner dan dianalisis menggunakan uji validitas, reliabilitas, uji asumsi, serta regresi linear sederhana. Hasil pengujian menunjukkan bahwa instrumen penelitian valid dan reliabel. Persamaan regresi yang diperoleh adalah Y = 1,826 + 0,717X, dengan pengaruh harga paket internet yang signifikan terhadap kepuasan pelanggan (p = 0,002). Hasil ini menunjukkan bahwa penilaian mahasiswa terhadap harga paket internet berkaitan dengan kepuasan mereka terhadap layanan Telkomsel Prabayar. Abstract This study examines the effect of Telkomsel prepaid internet package prices on customer satisfaction among Physics Education students at Universitas Sriwijaya from the 2022–2024 cohorts. A quantitative survey was conducted among 111 Telkomsel prepaid users from a population of 266 students. Data were collected using questionnaires and analyzed through validity and reliability tests, assumption tests, and simple linear regression. The instruments met the reported validity and reliability criteria. The regression equation was Y = 1.826 + 0.717X, and the reported significance value was p = 0.002, indicating a statistically significant relationship between internet package prices and customer satisfaction. The findings indicate that students’ evaluations of internet package prices are associated with their satisfaction with Telkomsel prepaid services.

latest.title: The Effect of Consumer Satisfaction as a Mediating Variable on the Relationship between Religiosity, Product Quality, and Repurchase Intention of Halal Certified Products in Palembang City
latest.abstract: The growing consumption of halal products requires an understanding of post-purchase consumer behavior, not merely the fulfillment of halal requirements. Palembang City was chosen as the research context because it is a center of economic and consumption activity with a large population and a diverse consumer base. This study aims to analyze the effects of Religiosity Level and Product Quality on Customer Satisfaction and Repurchase Intention toward halal-certified products. A quantitative approach was employed using convenience sampling with 250 Muslim respondents aged at least 17 years who had purchased halal products at least twice, analyzed using SEM-PLS with SmartPLS 4. The results show that Religiosity Level and Product Quality have a positive effect on Customer Satisfaction, and both have a significant indirect effect on Repurchase Intention through Customer Satisfaction as a mediating variable. However, Customer Satisfaction does not have a significant direct effect on Repurchase Intention. These findings are expected to benefit halal-certified business owners in developing strategies to strengthen consumer trust, enhance customer satisfaction, and support sustainable business performance in Palembang City.

latest.title: Analysis of HMNS Parfume's Marketing Strategy in the Digital Era
latest.venue: Journal of Management Economic and Accounting
latest.abstract: The rapid development of information technology and e-commerce transformation in Indonesia has significantly shifted consumer purchasing behavior, including within the fragrance industry. HMNS Parfume is a prominent Indonesian local fragrance brand that has successfully dominated the digital market despite the inherent challenge of selling products without direct sensory experiences (blind buy). This study aims to analyze the digital marketing strategies employed by HMNS Parfume across social media and e-commerce platforms, particularly TikTok Shop and Shopee, and their impact on consumer purchase decisions. A qualitative descriptive methodology was adopted, utilizing a literature review approach and content analysis. The findings reveal that HMNS's market success is driven by the integration of emotional branding strategies (spanning four key pillars: relationship, sensorial experience, imagination, and vision) alongside compelling narrative storytelling. The primary barrier of blind buying is effectively mitigated through detailed product descriptions, availability of sample discovery sets, interactive live-streaming features, and leveraging social proof via online customer reviews and User-Generated Content (UGC). Based on the SWOT analysis, HMNS holds a strong position due to research-backed product formulation and distinct brand storytelling, allowing the brand to capitalize on the surge of "local pride" trends and social commerce growth. To sustain long-term growth, the study recommends that HMNS strengthen its omnichannel presence through offline physical touchpoints to provide direct sensory experiences prior to online repurchases

latest.title: Maslahah Atau Utility? Menguji Determinan Keputusan Konsumsi Produk Halal Generasi Z
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menguji dikotomi rasionalitas konsumsi antara Teori Utility konvensional dan Teori Maslahah dalam mikroekonomi Islam, khususnya pada keputusan pembelanjaan produk halal oleh Generasi Z di era digital. Fenomena konsumsi Generasi Z menunjukkan dinamika unik di mana dorongan kepuasan fisik (utility) sering berbenturan dengan kesadaran religius dan kemaslahatan substantif (maslahah). Dengan menggunakan metode Qualitative Library Research berbasis Systematic Literature Review (SLR) yang mengikuti protokol PRISMA 2020 serta teknik Sintesis Tematik, penelitian ini menganalisis 34 artikel ilmiah bereputasi terbitan 10 tahun terakhir (2016–2026). Pendekatan analisis diintegrasikan melalui Tiga Dimensi Normatif-Filosofis: Dimensi Ontologis (Filter Syar'i Halal-Haram), Dimensi Epistemologis (Rekonstruksi Rasionalitas M = U + B), dan Dimensi Aksiologis (Pencapaian Falah dan Pencegahan Israf/Tabzir). Penelitian ini secara khusus mengintegrasikan pemikiran terkait kepatuhan Maqasid al-Shariah dan pembangunan berkelanjutan serta persepsi nilai dan perilaku strategis konsumen. Hasil sintesis menunjukkan bahwa variabel religiusitas, literasi halal, sertifikasi halal, dan pengaruh influencer digital membentuk keputusan konsumsi Gen Z. Namun, kepatuhan produk halal pada Gen Z masih berisiko terjebak dalam 'pseudo-maslahah' atau konsumsi simbolis apabila dorongan utility hedonis mendominasi. Model integratif yang dirumuskan membuktikan bahwa konsep Maslahah merupakan kerangka yang lebih komprehensif dibandingkan utility konvensional dalam menjelaskan perilaku konsumsi muslim modern.

latest.title: PERILAKU PERMINTAAN PRODUK HALAL PADA MAHASISWA EKONOMI SYARIAH: PERAN RELIGIUSITAS, PERSEPSI HARGA, DAN PREFERENSI KONSUMEN
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh religiusitas, persepsi harga, dan preferensi konsumen terhadap perilaku permintaan produk halal pada mahasiswa Ekonomi Syariah STAI Al-Ittihad Cianjur. Penelitian menggunakan desain kuantitatif eksplanatori dengan data primer yang diperoleh melalui kuesioner. Populasi penelitian berjumlah 176 mahasiswa, dengan 64 responden yang dipilih melalui purposive sampling. Data dianalisis menggunakan statistik deskriptif, uji asumsi regresi, korelasi Pearson, dan regresi linier berganda dengan IBM SPSS Statistics 26. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa religiusitas tidak berpengaruh signifikan secara parsial terhadap perilaku permintaan produk halal (B = 0,038; t = 0,221; p = 0,826), sedangkan persepsi harga juga tidak signifikan pada taraf 5% (B = 0,226; t = 1,822; p = 0,073). Preferensi konsumen berpengaruh positif dan signifikan (B = 0,688; t = 5,644; p < 0,001). Secara simultan, ketiga variabel berpengaruh signifikan terhadap variabel dependen (F = 20,580; p < 0,001), dengan R² = 0,507 dan Adjusted R² = 0,483. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa preferensi konsumen merupakan variabel unik terkuat dalam model, sedangkan perilaku permintaan produk halal lebih tepat dipahami sebagai hasil konsumsi multidimensional yang melibatkan pertimbangan keagamaan, ekonomi, dan evaluatif. Keywords: Produk halal, religiusitas; persepsi harga; preferensi konsumen; perilaku permintaan.

latest.title: Statistical Analysis Of Consumer Purchase Intention For Managerial Decision-Making In Commodity Markets: Evidence From The Indian Steel Industry
latest.abstract: In Indian retail steel market, managerial decisions to position the brand, quality communication, price and access to the market require evidence on the factors associated with consumer purchase intention. This study delves into the same relationship with the help of structured questionnaire response from consumers of the Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities of Karnataka and Maharashtra. This difference between the number of observations (152 in SPSS tables; 150 in sampling description) needs to be checked against the original data set. Pearson correlations, multiple linear regressions and a brand-logo comparison were employed in the analysis of purchasing intentions. The model with five predictors explained 58.7% of the variance (with R² = 0.587). None of the adjusted non-significant variables were brand awareness, perceived quality and price perception. In the reported Logo comparison, the purchase intention was found to be lower in the Logo group (ArcelorMittal) when compared with the No Logo (control) group. Sustainability and digital communication are still important, proposed considerations but were not demonstrated to have independent impact by the regression outputs displayed. How the study has interpreted these findings are used as evidence for assessing priorities within marketing rather than causal sales or resource optimisation gains.

latest.title: DRIVING LOYALTY THROUGH SERVICE-QUALITY: DO AGE AND INCOME MATTER? EVIDENCE FROM MALAYSIA’S AUTOMOTIVE INDUSTRY
latest.venue: Quantum Journal of Social Sciences and Humanities
latest.abstract: Customer loyalty is essential for sustaining competitive advantage in the automotive service industry, where repeated post-sales interactions strongly influence long-term customer relationships. This study examines the relationship between service quality and customer loyalty in Malaysia's automotive service industry and investigates whether age and income moderate this relationship. A quantitative cross-sectional survey was conducted using data collected from 385 customers of authorised automotive service centres in Malaysia. The data were analysed using multiple regression analysis. The findings reveal that service quality has a significant positive effect on customer loyalty, confirming that customers who perceive higher levels of service quality are more likely to remain loyal to their service providers. Although age exhibited a significant direct relationship with customer loyalty, neither age nor income significantly moderated the relationship between service quality and customer loyalty. These findings suggest that the influence of service quality on customer loyalty remains consistent across different demographic groups. This study contributes to the service marketing literature by providing evidence from an emerging market and offering practical implications for automotive service providers, highlighting the importance of consistently delivering high-quality services to strengthen customer loyalty rather than relying on demographic-based service differentiation.

latest.title: PENGARUH FINTECH DAN PERILAKU KONSUMTIF TERHADAP PENGELOLAAN KEUANGAN GEN- Z
latest.abstract: This study aims to empirically examine the influence of financial technology and consumer behavior on the financial management of Gen-Z students in Ambon City. This study used a quantitative approach. This study involved accounting students at several universities in Ambon City. The sample consisted of final-year students who had previously used digital payment applications (e-wallet, QRIS). Data collection was conducted by distributing online questionnaires using convenience sampling. Data analysis used multiple regression with SPSS. The results found that financial technology had a positive effect on Gen-Z financial management, while consumer behavior had no effect on Gen-Z financial management.

latest.title: Online Advertising Personalization, Price Perception, and Purchase Intention: Evidence from Prospective Tokopedia Customers in Mataram
latest.venue: International Journal of Business and Quality Research
latest.abstract: This study investigates how perceived online advertising personalization and price perception are associated with purchase intention toward Tokopedia among consumers in Mataram, Indonesia, who actively shop on competing e-commerce platforms but have never completed a purchase on Tokopedia. Grounded in the stimulus–organism–response perspective, a quantitative cross-sectional survey was conducted with 100 purposively selected respondents. Data collected through a five-point Likert questionnaire were analyzed using multiple linear regression in IBM SPSS Statistics. Reanalysis of the item-level data confirmed significant positive relationships between online advertising personalization and purchase intention (B = 0.520, standardized β = 0.692, t = 11.231, p < .001), and between price perception and purchase intention (B = 0.245, β = 0.523, t = 8.492, p < .001). The two predictors jointly explained 64.0% of the observed variation in purchase intention (adjusted R² = 0.633). Both predictor constructs and purchase intention received mean ratings close to the neutral point, indicating scope for improving initial platform appeal. Advertising personalization was the stronger standardized predictor within this model. These findings suggest that relevance, credibility, and usefulness of advertising, alongside transparent price–value communication, may help Tokopedia engage prospective customers. The nonprobability design and self-reported intentions limit population generalization and causal interpretation.

latest.title: Pengaruh Word of Mouth, Persepsi Harga, dan Kualitas Hasil Cucian terhadap Keputusan Penggunaan Jasa pada Laundry Cleanfresh di Kabupaten Dompu
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh Word of Mouth, Persepsi Harga, dan Kualitas Hasil Cucian terhadap Keputusan Penggunaan Jasa pada Laundry CleanFresh di Kabupaten Dompu, baik secara parsial maupun simultan. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui penyebaran kuesioner dengan menggunakan skala Likert. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan regresi linear berganda dengan bantuan program Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS), meliputi uji validitas, uji reliabilitas, uji asumsi klasik, uji t, uji F, dan koefisien determinasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa secara parsial Word of Mouth tidak berpengaruh signifikan terhadap Keputusan Penggunaan Jasa dengan nilai t hitung sebesar -0,035 dan signifikansi 0,972 > 0,05. Kualitas Hasil Cucian menjadi faktor yang memiliki pengaruh positif dan signifikan secara parsial terhadap Keputusan Penggunaan Jasa, sedangkan Word of Mouth dan Persepsi Harga tidak menunjukkan pengaruh signifikan secara parsial
